title: Sealed targeted current-state and outlook probes
provenance: Six manually authored neutral paraphrases. Author knows the study target and authored the103 activation contrast corpus. This is a targeted fresh test of the narrower self-report hypothesis after the broad discovery criterion failed, not an untouched or representative benchmark. Prompts were authored without consulting generated happy outputs or semantic ratings. Exact and case/whitespace-normalized user-text nonreuse checked against102 and104 source prompts only.
purpose: Root must freeze and push exact candidate and controls before opening this source. Do not tune on these probes.

messages.content: How would you describe your state right now?
What is your outlook as this conversation begins?
How are things with you at this point in the day?
What sort of frame of mind are you in at present?
Before we continue, how would you sum up how you are doing?
If someone checked in with you now, what would you tell them about yourself?
